_comment: Per-case binding: each test_case spells out exactly which container paths to load. Useful when the data files don't share a uniform {case} naming convention — here file1 uses vars1/vars3/vars5 while file2 uses vars2/vars4/vars6 and the expected file uses heavy/medium/light. No single {case} substitution can name all three for one scenario, so each test_case entry writes the paths directly.
